root.label: Justice Department rules out reopening Powell probe

events.label: Justice Department rules out reopening Powell probe

slots.name: investigation status
slots.sentence: Attorney General Todd Blanche said Friday that the Justice Department wouldn’t reopen its criminal investigation of former Fed Chair Jerome Powell regarding the central bank’s headquarters renovation

slots.name: criminal charges
slots.sentence: That investigation concluded two weeks ago without any criminal charges, and the Department of Justice said it would not pursue the matter further.
